trip_tokyo_sample_01.title: Tokyo Neon & Heritage Odyssey
trip_tokyo_sample_01.overview: A balanced 4-day Tokyo journey grouping historic Asakusa, buzzing Shibuya & Shinjuku, futuristic Odaiba, and artistic Roppongi with zero cross-city backtracking.

emergency_contacts.embassy_note: Locate in Minato City / Roppongi embassy quarter.

packing_tips: Pasmo/Suica IC transport card or Apple Wallet transit pass
Comfortable slip-on walking shoes (temples require shoes-off)
Small hand towel and pocket trash bag

days.transit_fatigue_score: Low (All locations within 1.5 km walking & 1 subway stop)

morning.title: Organic Vegetarian & Vegan Brunch at Ain Soph. Journey Asakusa
morning.description: Savor a wholesome, organic vegetarian and vegan brunch featuring seasonal Japanese-inspired dishes, fresh tofu bowls, and plant‑based sweets—all prepared with locally sourced ingredients. The relaxed café atmosphere sits just a short walk from Senso‑ji, keeping you within the Asakusa & Ueno cultural cluster.
morning.pro_tip: Arrive early or reserve a seat to avoid the mid‑morning rush; ask for the "Omotenashi" set menu for a curated tasting of their best organic dishes.

lunch.title: Tempura Daikokuya or Asakusa Imahan
lunch.description: Savor crispy sesame-oil fried prawn tempura over warm rice in a heritage tatami setting established in 1887.
lunch.dietary_tags: Vegetarian tempura sets available upon request

afternoon.title: Ueno Park, Tokyo National Museum & Shinobazu Pond
afternoon.description: Stroll through peaceful Ueno Onshi Park, inspect priceless samurai armor and woodblock prints, and paddle on Shinobazu Pond.
afternoon.pro_tip: The gallery gardens behind the main building are a peaceful hidden oasis.

evening.title: Tokyo Skytree Sunset & Solamachi Riverside Dining
evening.description: Witness the glowing Tokyo megalopolis from the 350m Tembo Deck, followed by dinner and craft beer along the Sumida river promenade.
evening.pro_tip: Book Tembo Deck timed tickets 3 days in advance to catch golden hour sunset.

days.transit_fatigue_score: Low (Continuous pedestrian walk from Harajuku to Shibuya)

morning.title: Meiji Jingu Shrine & Forest Walk
morning.description: Escape the bustle through towering cedar groves leading to Tokyo's grandest Shinto shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji.
morning.pro_tip: Write an Ema wooden prayer tablet at the sacred camphor trees.

lunch.title: Afuri Harajuku (Yuzu Shio Ramen)
lunch.description: Famous light broth infused with fresh yuzu citrus, charcoal-grilled chashu pork, and crisp bamboo shoots.
lunch.dietary_tags: Outstanding seasonal vegan ramen bowl on menu

afternoon.title: Cat Street Boutiques & Miyashita Park Rooftop
afternoon.description: Wander trendsetting indie boutiques along Cat Street connecting Harajuku to Shibuya, ending with matcha soft-serve on Miyashita Park's elevated lawns.
afternoon.pro_tip: Great vintage fashion and local Japanese sneaker concept stores.

evening.title: Shibuya Sky Observation & Nonbei Yokocho Izakaya
evening.description: Stand atop Shibuya Sky 360-degree open-air glass deck overlooking the famous Scramble Crossing, then enjoy yakitori skewers in vintage lantern alley.
evening.pro_tip: Lock coats and bags in lockers before stepping onto the Shibuya Sky roof.

morning.title: teamLab Planets Tokyo Immersive Sensory Art
morning.description: Wade through knee-deep water, walk through infinite crystal mirrors, and float among virtual floating orchids in this world-renowned digital museum.
morning.pro_tip: Wear pants that easily roll above the knees.

lunch.title: Toyosu Fish Market Senkyaku Banrai Dining
lunch.description: Sample melt-in-your-mouth bluefin Otoro sushi and grilled scallops freshly landed from Tokyo Bay.

afternoon.title: Odaiba Seaside Promenade & Life-Sized Unicorn Gundam
afternoon.description: Watch the transforming Unicorn Gundam statue, explore Aqua City waterfront, and snap photos of the mini Statue of Liberty framed against Rainbow Bridge.
afternoon.pro_tip: Gundam transformation show runs every hour on the hour.

evening.title: Tokyo Bay Himiko Water Bus Cruise & Ginza Dinner
evening.description: Board the futuristic Leiji Matsumoto-designed boat to Hinode pier, then dine on wagyu beef in glamorous Ginza.
evening.pro_tip: Window-shopping flagship architect-designed boutique buildings in Ginza is stunning by night.

morning.title: Tokyo Imperial Palace East Gardens & Nijubashi Bridge
morning.description: Stroll ancient stone castle foundation moats, meticulously manicured bonsai trees, and the iconic Nijubashi double bridge.
morning.pro_tip: East Gardens are closed Mondays and Fridays.

lunch.title: Marunouchi Brick Square Terrace Bistro
lunch.description: Enjoy a garden patio lunch with freshly baked baguettes, seasonal salads, and artisan gateaux.
lunch.dietary_tags: Vegetarian quiche and garden salads available

afternoon.title: Mori Art Museum & Roppongi Hills Architecture
afternoon.description: Discover contemporary global exhibitions on the 53rd floor of Roppongi Hills Mori Tower and pose with Louise Bourgeois' giant Maman spider sculpture.
afternoon.pro_tip: Museum ticket includes admission to the 52F Tokyo City View indoor observation deck.

evening.title: Tokyo Tower Twilight Illuminations & Farewell Kaiseki
evening.description: Gaze up at Tokyo Tower glowing in warm orange lights from Shiba Park, followed by a celebratory multi-course seasonal Japanese kaiseki dinner.
evening.pro_tip: Prince Park Tower hotel basement lawn provides the most postcard-perfect angle of Tokyo Tower.

trip_9da50fa5.overview: Four days of intimate exploration, each day clustered in a single Barcelona neighborhood so you wander hand‑in‑hand without back‑tracking. From Gothic charm to bohemian El Born, modernist Eixample and leafy Gràcia, the itinerary balances iconic sights, market bites and boutique dining.

morning.title: Barcelona Cathedral Visit
morning.description: Explore the soaring Gothic nave and rooftop views of the old city.
morning.pro_tip: Buy a combined ticket with the cloister to skip the line.

lunch.title: Bar Pinotxo at La Boqueria
lunch.description: Sample fresh market tapas—jamón ibérico, grilled squid, and a glass of cava.
lunch.location_name: Bar Pinotxo, La Boqueria, La Rambla

afternoon.title: Picasso Museum Tour
afternoon.description: Discover Picasso’s early works and his Barcelona years in a historic mansion.
afternoon.pro_tip: Reserve a timed entry online to avoid queues.

evening.title: Dinner at Los Caracoles
evening.description: Classic Catalan dishes—roast lamb, seafood paella—in a historic tavern with a romantic ambience.
evening.location_name: Los Caracoles, Carrer del Consell de Cent
evening.pro_tip: Request a table by the window for a candlelit view of the narrow streets.

morning.title: Santa Maria del Mar
morning.description: Marvel at the pure Catalan Gothic architecture of this 14th‑century basilica.
morning.pro_tip: Climb the towers for panoramic city views; tickets are cheap.

lunch.title: El Xampanyet Tapas
lunch.description: Enjoy bubbling cava and traditional bites—anchovies, cheese, and patatas bravas—in a lively cellar.

afternoon.title: El Born Centre de Cultura i Memòria
afternoon.description: Walk through the archaeological ruins of medieval Barcelona beneath a modern market hall.
afternoon.pro_tip: Combine with a quick coffee at the adjacent market stalls.

evening.title: Seafood Dinner at Cal Pep
evening.description: Savor fresh seafood—garlic shrimp, grilled octopus—and a lively bar scene.
evening.location_name: Cal Pep, Plaça de les Olles
evening.pro_tip: Arrive early or join the queue; no reservations, but the wait is worth it.

morning.title: Casa Batlló Exploration
morning.description: Tour Gaudí’s whimsical façade and interior, a masterpiece of color and light.
morning.pro_tip: Buy the ‘Fast Pass’ to skip the main queue.

lunch.title: Cervecería Catalana
lunch.description: Vibrant tapas bar with a wide selection of small plates and craft beers.

afternoon.title: Fundació Antoni Tàpies
afternoon.description: Experience avant‑garde Catalan art in a striking modernist building.
afternoon.pro_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions; they’re often free with the museum ticket.

evening.title: Tasting Menu at Cinc Sentits
evening.description: Elegant 5‑course tasting of seasonal Catalan cuisine with wine pairings.
evening.pro_tip: Reserve at least a week ahead; request a window seat for sunset views.

morning.title: Park Güell Visit
morning.description: Stroll through Gaudí’s colorful mosaics and panoramic terraces overlooking the city.
morning.pro_tip: Enter early to avoid crowds; the Monumental Zone ticket is required for the main area.

lunch.title: La Pepita
lunch.description: Creative small plates—truffle egg toast, pork cheeks—and a relaxed patio vibe.

afternoon.title: Casa Vicens Tour
afternoon.description: Explore Gaudí’s first major work, a Moorish‑inspired villa now a museum.
afternoon.pro_tip: Combine with a walk through the nearby Plaça del Sol for coffee.

evening.title: Dinner at Suculent
evening.description: Cozy bistro offering seasonal Catalan dishes, perfect for a romantic final night.
evening.pro_tip: Ask for the chef’s tasting plate; it’s a hidden favorite among locals.

emergency_contacts.embassy_note: Register with your embassy; Spanish consulates in Barcelona can be reached at +34 93 202 30 00.

packing_tips: Comfortable walking shoes for cobblestone streets
Light layers; evenings can be breezy even in summer
Reusable water bottle (tap water is safe)
A small day‑backpack for market finds and a portable charger

trip_00e85bd5.overview: Four days of intimate exploration in Indore, each day anchored in a single neighbourhood so you wander without back‑tracking. From historic Old Town charm to bustling food bazaars and cultured museum districts, the itinerary balances iconic sights, street‑food delights and relaxed café moments.

morning.title: Rajwada Palace & Bada Ganpati
morning.description: Guided walk through the 18th‑century Holkar Rajwada palace followed by a quick photo stop at the massive Bada Ganpati idol, a living piece of local devotion.
morning.pro_tip: Hire a local guide at the gate (≈₹300) for richer anecdotes and skip the midday crowd.

lunch.title: Nehru Café
lunch.description: Savor the iconic poha‑jalebi combo on a sun‑lit balcony overlooking the palace courtyard.

afternoon.title: Lal Bagh Palace Gardens
afternoon.description: Stroll the well‑preserved gardens of Lal Bagh Palace, admire the European‑style architecture and enjoy a quiet tea at the on‑site café.
afternoon.pro_tip: Visit the palace just before sunset for softer light and fewer visitors.

evening.title: Madhav Bazar Dinner & Live Folk
evening.description: Dine on dhokla, kebabs and thali at a rooftop venue while a local folk troupe performs traditional Malwa music.
evening.pro_tip: Reserve a corner table for sunset views; carry a light scarf for the cool evening breeze.

morning.title: Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum
morning.description: Interactive exhibits showcasing tribal crafts, costumes and musical instruments of central India.
morning.location_name: Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum, Museum Road
morning.pro_tip: Take the audio guide (₹150) for in‑depth stories behind each artefact.

lunch.title: Bhojanalay at Museum Café
lunch.description: Enjoy a set menu of dal‑bafla, bhutte ka kees and fresh lassi in a serene garden setting.

afternoon.title: Indore Central Museum (Indore Museum)
afternoon.description: Explore galleries of ancient sculptures, colonial paintings and the famed 'Indore Pithora' folk art.
afternoon.pro_tip: Visit the temporary exhibition on Malwa miniature paintings (extra ₹200).

evening.title: Rooftop Dinner at The Grand Café
evening.description: Modern Indian cuisine with a view of the illuminated museum complex; try the mushroom tikka and mango panna cotta.
evening.pro_tip: Ask for a table near the glass rail for the best night‑city panorama.

morning.title: Sarafa Bazaar Heritage Walk
morning.description: Guided stroll through the historic gold‑smith market, learning about traditional jewelry making and sampling early‑morning sweets.
morning.pro_tip: Visit the small museum inside the bazaar (free) to see antique coins.

lunch.title: Chappan Dukan Street Eats
lunch.description: Create your own thali: try bhutte ka kees, jalebi, and the famous Indori namkeen from multiple stalls.

afternoon.title: Indore Art Gallery (Madhav Rao Art Space)
afternoon.description: Contemporary exhibitions featuring local painters, photographers and a rotating craft showcase.
afternoon.location_name: Madhav Rao Art Space, Near Chappan Dukan
afternoon.pro_tip: Free entry on Wednesdays; check the schedule before you go.

evening.title: Sarafa Night Food Market
evening.description: After dusk Sarafa transforms into a bustling night market—indulge in sev puri, dahi pakora, and the legendary 'Indori poha' under lantern light.
evening.pro_tip: Carry small change; best stalls are near the central clock tower.

morning.title: Indore Railway Station Heritage Tour
morning.description: Explore the colonial‑era station architecture, visit the small museum inside, and watch the bustling platform life.
morning.pro_tip: Take a quick photo from Platform 1 for the best façade view.

lunch.title: Madhya Pradesh Haat Café
lunch.description: Relax with a light lunch of paneer tikka wraps and a glass of fresh sugarcane juice on the riverfront terrace.
lunch.location_name: Madhya Pradesh Haat Café, Riverfront Road

afternoon.title: Kanch Mandir (Glass Temple) & Gandhi Hall Walk
afternoon.description: Visit the intricately mirrored Kanch Mandir, then stroll to nearby Gandhi Hall for a quiet reflection on India's independence legacy.
afternoon.pro_tip: Dress modestly (shoulders covered) for temple entry.

evening.title: Riverfront Dinner at The Riverside Lounge
evening.description: Fine‑dining with a view of the Shipra River; try the herb‑crusted lamb and mango kulfi for dessert.
evening.pro_tip: Book a window seat 24 hrs ahead; the river lights create a romantic ambience.

emergency_contacts.embassy_note: Register with your embassy; Indian consulates can be reached via 011‑2411‑1111.

packing_tips: Light breathable clothing for warm days, plus a light shawl for evenings.
Comfortable walking shoes (preferably closed‑toe) for cobblestone streets.
Reusable water bottle and basic hand sanitizer for street‑food outings.
Plug adapter (Type C/D) and a portable charger for on‑the‑go navigation.

trip_0383b7bc.overview: Four days of tightly clustered exploration let you wander Indore’s historic Old City, bustling Chappan Dukan, civic museum quarter, and the spiritual Khajrana enclave without back‑tracking. Each day stays within a walkable 1 km radius, balancing iconic sights, street‑food feasts, and cultural venues.

morning.title: Rajwada Palace Tour
morning.description: Guided walk through the 18th‑century Holkar royal palace, admire frescoes and the grand Durbar Hall.
morning.pro_tip: Visit early to avoid the mid‑day crowd and get a free audio guide at the entry desk.

lunch.title: Madhav Sweets & Restaurant
lunch.description: Enjoy a traditional thali with dal‑bafla, poha, and sweet jalebi on a sun‑lit patio.

afternoon.title: Kanch Mandir (Glass Temple) Visit
afternoon.description: Marvel at the intricate stained‑glass interiors depicting Hindu deities; a quiet spot for reflection.
afternoon.pro_tip: No shoes required; photography allowed only without flash.

evening.title: Sarafa Bazaar Night Food Crawl
evening.description: Stroll the illuminated bazaar sampling bhutte ka kees, jalebi, and kebabs from legendary stalls.
evening.pro_tip: Carry small cash; the best bites are at the outer lanes before the crowd peaks.

morning.title: Indore Art Gallery (Madhya Kala Parishad)
morning.description: Explore rotating exhibitions of tribal art, contemporary paintings, and local crafts.
morning.pro_tip: Free entry on Tuesdays; check the current exhibit brochure at the entrance.

lunch.title: Nizam's Kachori Corner
lunch.description: Crispy kachoris stuffed with peas and served with tangy chutney—Indore’s iconic snack.

afternoon.title: Chappan Dukan Heritage Walk
afternoon.description: Guided walk through the 9‑storey food arcade, learning its history and sampling mini‑tastes of poha, sev, and jalebi.
afternoon.pro_tip: Wear comfortable shoes; the alley’s shade offers a pleasant respite from the sun.

evening.title: Evening at The Grand Thakar
evening.description: Sit on the rooftop of The Grand Thakar for a multi‑cuisine dinner with live jazz and city lights.
evening.pro_tip: Reserve a table with a view at least 2 hours ahead; the rooftop is popular on weekends.

morning.title: Indore City Museum (Central Museum)
morning.description: Discover artifacts from the Holkar era, ancient sculptures, and a rare coin collection.
morning.pro_tip: Combine the museum visit with the free guided tour that starts every hour on the hour.

lunch.title: The Grand Thakar (Lunch)
lunch.description: A la carte menu featuring paneer tikka, millet roti, and seasonal desserts in a stylish lounge.

afternoon.title: Madhya Pradesh Hall (Indore Hall)
afternoon.description: Visit the heritage hall that hosts rotating art exhibitions and cultural performances.
afternoon.pro_tip: Check the schedule; a folk dance show often runs at 5 pm on weekdays.

evening.title: Madhya Mahal Rooftop Dinner
evening.description: Enjoy a rooftop dinner with a panoramic view of the city skyline, featuring a live acoustic set.
evening.pro_tip: Arrive 15 minutes early for the best seating; dress smart‑casual.

morning.title: Khajrana Ganesh Temple Pilgrimage
morning.description: Pay respects at the 15‑ft Ganesh idol, explore the surrounding prayer hall, and observe local rituals.
morning.pro_tip: Dress modestly; modest footwear is required inside the sanctum.

lunch.title: Riverfront Café – Lotus View
lunch.description: Light lunch of grilled paneer salad, corn soup, and fresh fruit juices overlooking the Khan River.

afternoon.title: Khajrana Handicraft Market Exploration
afternoon.description: Shop for Madhya Pradesh handloom fabrics, brassware, and tribal jewellery; practice haggling with friendly vendors.
afternoon.pro_tip: Carry small change; most stalls prefer cash for quick bargaining.

evening.title: Sunset Dinner at The Riverside Terrace
evening.description: Dine al fresco with a view of the illuminated river; menu includes dhokla, kebabs, and a dessert platter.
evening.pro_tip: Book a riverside table; the sunset view peaks at 19:15 hrs in October.

emergency_contacts.embassy_note: Indian nationals: keep a copy of your passport and a local SIM; foreign travelers should register with their embassy.
